gloss: to write down, to record, to note

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {記|しる}していませんでした

definitions.gloss: to write down, to record, to note, to document
definitions.explanation: To put something into writing for the purpose of recording or preserving information. More formal and literary than 書く (to write), with a nuance of documenting or making a record.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日記|にっき}→日記：01486_nikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{記|しる}した。
examples.english: I recorded my memories in a diary.

examples.japanese: {歴史書|れきししょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧はこう{記|しる}されて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: It is recorded as follows in the history book.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用紙|ようし}→用紙：09588_youshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{記|しる}して⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write your name and address on the form.

notes:
USAGE:
{記|しる}す is a godan verb that is more formal and literary than ⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write). It implies writing with the intent to document, preserve, or communicate important information. The passive form {記|しる}されて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (is recorded/written) is very common, especially when citing historical or official documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{日記|にっき}→日記：01486_nikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{記|しる}す: to record in a diary
- ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{記|しる}される: to be recorded in history
- ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{記|しる}す: to write one's name
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{記|しる}されて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: it is written/recorded as ~
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{記|しる}す: to engrave in one's heart (to remember deeply)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write) is the everyday, general word. {記|しる}す is more formal and emphasizes the act of recording or documenting. ⟦{記録|きろく}する→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧ (to record) is similar but focuses more on systematic data recording. {記|しる}す has a more literary, personal quality.
